# `request-body-became-optional`

Request body became optional

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `request-body-became-optional` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Request bodies ([RULES.md section 5](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A required request body is now optional.

## Why this default

Clients that send a body keep working.

## Example

From test case [`request-body-became-optional`](../../test/cases/request-body-became-optional/): Required → optional.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
        operationId: createPet
        requestBody:
-         required: true
+         required: false
          content:
            application/json:
```

Findings:

- `request-body-became-optional` · info · POST /pets

## Test cases

The example above is the only test case for this rule.

